turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I’m Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
turns.patient_response:
Hello, doctor. Well, I guess I'm here because... ever since my choir friend passed away so suddenly, I just haven't been myself. 

I've been finding myself crying over silly things, like the potluck lists. And I get all worked up about phone calls that I used to handle easy. I've even started missing church planning things, which is something I never, ever would have missed before. I just don't feel right, and I thought I better come in and talk to someone.
